title: SCPN Spheromak Core
description: Governed device-family repository for the spheromak configuration within the SCPN Reactor Systems Research Group. Evidence maturity computational_prototype: a validated device configuration model, diagnostic and clock semantics aligned with the SCPN Phase Orchestrator observability catalogue, level-0 device physics (Taylor eigenvalue, relaxed-state field and formation disposition), and tessellated and B-rep device models with STL, glTF and STEP exports. All parameter sets are synthetic; no real machine is described, and the claim inventory is empty.
